t: Congolese franc - Wikipedia
s: 6 days ago - The Congolese franc (French: franc congolais, code FC; Dutch: Congolees frank) is the currency of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the past, it was subdivided into 100 centimes. However, centimes no longer have a practical value and are no longer used.
